description: This file defines the main application component 'App' for a React-based frontend project. It sets up context providers for theming, authentication, toast notifications, and models, along with routing and a chatbot overlay. It primarily composes various context providers and routes to form the application shell.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that provides theming, routing, authentication, and other context providers, and renders the ChatbotOverlay.
